title: Decoding while Adapting: Zero-Shot Online Speaker Adaptation via Audio-Textual Prompts for Elderly Speech Recognition
title_zh: 边解码边适应：基于音频-文本提示的老年语音识别零样本在线说话人自适应
abstract_en: This paper proposes a novel cross-utterance audio-textual prompts based speaker adaptation approach for elderly speech recognition. It enables zero-shot, real-time adaptation to unseen speakers. Speech and text embeddings are extracted from the current and a few preceding utterances, before being fused in a cross-modal manner to produce compact speaker prompts that are more consistent than i/x-vectors and ECAPA-TDNN features. Experiments on the English DementiaBank Pitt and Cantonese JCCOCC MoCA elderly speech datasets suggest that the proposed online adaptation outperforms the speaker-independent (SI) model by statistically significant word error rate (WER) or character error rate (CER) reductions of 0.61% and 1.22% absolute (2.99% and 4.48% relative). Real-time factor (RTF) speed-up ratios of up to 9.83 times are obtained over offline batch-mode adaptation.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于跨话语音频-文本提示（audio-textual prompts）的说话人自适应方法，用于老年语音识别。该方法可对未见过的说话人进行零样本、实时自适应：从当前话语及少量前序话语中提取语音与文本嵌入，并通过跨模态融合生成紧凑的说话人提示。相比 i/x-vectors 和 ECAPA-TDNN 特征，这些提示具有更高的一致性。在 English DementiaBank Pitt 和 Cantonese JCCOCC MoCA 两个老年语音数据集上的实验表明，所提出的在线自适应方法相较说话人无关（SI）模型取得了统计显著的错误率下降：WER/CER 分别绝对降低 0.61% 和 1.22%，相对降低 2.99% 和 4.48%。此外，相比离线批处理自适应，该方法的实时因子（RTF）最高获得 9.83 倍加速。
key_points_zh: 提出跨话语 audio-textual prompts 说话人自适应框架，支持未见说话人的零样本在线适应。
方法利用当前及前序话语的语音和文本嵌入，并进行跨模态融合，生成紧凑且稳定的 speaker prompts。
相比传统 i/x-vectors 与 ECAPA-TDNN 特征，所生成提示在说话人表征一致性上更优。
在 DementiaBank Pitt 与 JCCOCC MoCA 老年语音数据集上，相比 SI 模型取得显著 WER/CER 降低。
在线方案相较离线批处理自适应显著提升效率，RTF 最高加速 9.83 倍。

llm_assessment.comment: A practical online elderly-speech adaptation method, but it remains mainly an ASR paper rather than an agent interaction contribution.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作是实用的老年语音在线自适应方法，但主要仍属于ASR研究而非智能体交互贡献。
